Stories A (Layer C, V24), B (declared limits of assurance + the human review-debt marker) and E (canon seeding) move to batch-89, to be authored over a STILL oracle. The binding constraint was not file count -- 6 source files across 10 increments, max 3 in any one, passes the budget with headroom -- but FIVE ORACLE MOVES OF WHICH EXACTLY ONE WAS SEQUENCED: V22's census, the _artifacts loader, V2's resolution, V5/V8's sentences (57 of 61 records change what V5 says about them), and -- found at the station-4 PDR and MISSING from this list as first written -- the V23 grammar. RE-DERIVED 2026-08-25 (PDR-2026-08-25-batch-88#D1 and #D4): the canon-census baseline is 306 of 570 MEASURED 2026-08-25, shipped reads 302 of 570. The figures 276 -> 280 of 544 are SUPERSEDED and preserved here rather than deleted; the +4 delta survives every re-measurement, the baseline survives none, because batch-88 declared 26 ids of its own while the figure was being written -- the denominator hazard biting the very number that measures it. The _artifacts move is now 0 block -> 0 block: its 14 block -> 0 window CLOSED when P1 authored the requirements record, verified by executing the loader. Of the five moves only TWO are still moving today -- V22's census and V5's sentences; moves 2 and 5 were stilled by ordinary work rather than by design. THE SCOPE CUT STANDS on the two that remain, but its original derivation is refuted: cite the re-executed table at 01-requirements.md section 0.3, never this summary. Story C stays because V25's oracle is `git ls-remote`, external to every number this batch moves. THE NINE FIXES: V22 oracle (substring -> token membership) + its scope-naming message, LANDING FIRST per operator ruling with the re-baseline recorded; V23 STRICT grammar (a record, a decision inside it, and a VERSION each distinctly expressible -- the permissive hyphen form is REJECTED); V5 PASS != NOOP (it has reported 'no ledger expression found' for 57 of 61 batches, identically for a correct ledger and for none); the _artifacts F-7 residue; V8 case-insensitive map resolution; V8 root-file message; V2 substring -> token; V6 line-scoped -> statement-scoped; Pillow's declared home. The original acceptance criterion 1 (no new rule on the synthetic-exemption list) is insufficient alone -- V5 proves a rule can carry arms, pass them, and still be inert.

decisions_log.notes: THREE OPERATOR RULINGS. (1) The V22 oracle fix (substring -> token membership) LANDS FIRST, before any canon-seeding evidence is produced, with an explicit re-baseline 276 -> 280 recorded in this objective. Operator verbatim: 'Si aterrizalo primero'. (2) The V23 grammar is STRICT -- a record, a decision inside it, and a VERSION of it must each be distinctly expressible and checkable; the permissive hyphen form that conflates a version with a hyphenated batch dir is REJECTED. Operator verbatim: 'Debe ser estricto, hay que arreglarlo'. The analysis agent had flagged this as a design ruling it would not make; it is now made. (3) A HUMAN REVIEW MARKER is required, and the operator's framing is a REVIEW-DEBT LEDGER rather than a boolean: each batch proceeds autonomously and ACCRUES review debt; the marker discharges it, recording reviewer name 'Javier Granados' (an optional reviewer-id field reserved for organisational context), the DATE, the PHASE at which review happened -- it may be early or immediately before the final commit -- and authored-by beside reviewed-by so a one-sided sign-off is visible. Whatever the review turns up goes to the backlog. The guarding rule must NOT claim to verify the review's QUALITY, only that it occurred, by whom and when. SCOPE ALARM RAISED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR, not by the operator: the batch entered as 4 stories and the session added NINE measured fixes (V22 oracle+message, V23 strict, V5 PASS!=NOOP, _artifacts F-7, V8 casing, V8 root message, V2 substring, V6 line-scoping, Pillow) plus the marker. Family E already fired at 4 stories / 5 increments; thirteen pieces fire everything. RECOMMENDED SPLIT: batch-88 = rule-integrity fixes + stories A/B/C; batch-89 = the canon-seeding story with the corrected oracle. This satisfies ruling (1) -- V22 still lands before seeding evidence exists -- without stacking thirteen pieces behind one gate. The P1 architect was dispatched with an explicit instruction to RULE on whether the scope is authorable in one batch, argued from source-file and increment counts, and to propose the cut if it is not. NON-NEGOTIABLE CARRIED INTO P1, from the V5 finding: every new or patched rule owes a PASS != NOOP arm, and its GREEN arm must assert the PASS SENTENCE rather than the absence of a BLOCK. Acceptance criterion 1 of the original proposal (no new rule on the synthetic-exemption list) is INSUFFICIENT alone and is widened accordingly. V16 resolved: the 11 excalidraw diagrams that dirtied the flow repo are the operator's own parallel session, authoring diagrams for EXTERNAL human audit of the process. Not swept, not this session's.
